features.name: Catalogs (Geographic + System)
features.description: All lookup tables: Venezuelan geographic hierarchy (countries/states/municipalities/parishes) + 36 system catalog tables. Prerequisite for all profile arneses.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Extend users with first_name/last_name (GENERATED name), document, phone, photo, soft deletes. Add user_addresses and user_documents.

features.name: Role Profiles
features.description: Extend students with academic fields + student_guardians pivot (migrates guardian_id). Add guardian_profiles and staff_profiles.

features.name: Student Background
features.description: Education background, language skills, family profile, and demographic profile.

features.name: Socioeconomic & Health
features.description: Sensitive modules: socioeconomic study, student benefits, health profile, housing profile + services, LOPD user consents.

features.name: User Form Views
features.description: Full create/edit user form UI: role picker, 17 sections, 4 roles, tabs, sidebar nav, progress indicator, autosave. Frontend only — no backend wiring.

features.name: User Form Connect
features.description: Connect the user form UI to the backend. Progressive section-by-section saves: Create.vue (S01+S02) creates the user, Edit.vue (S03-S17) saves each profile section independently via existing endpoints.

features.name: User Edit Auth Fix
features.description: Fix three Admin FormRequests using hasAnyRole('Administrador') instead of Gate::authorize() — admins with only the 'Admin' role get 403 saving S10, S13, S16.

features.name: User Edit Catalog IDs
features.description: Migrate S04/S09/S16/S17 from hardcoded string catalogs to DB-backed ID selects. S17 always 422 (BLOQUEANTE); S04/S09/S16 cause silent data loss.

features.name: Geographic Seeder Fix
features.description: Countries and states tables are empty in dev. Register GeographicSeeder in DatabaseSeeder and add a test asserting catalogData.countries is non-empty.

features.name: Role Sub-Record Integrity
features.description: Users with a Spatie role (Profesor/Estudiante/Representante) but no sub-record (professors/students/guardians) get silent early-return on save. Fix: firstOrCreate in Actions + artisan fix command.

features.name: Student Academic Show & Edit Wiring
features.description: Wire Edit button to /security/users/{id}/edit. Implement Show page /academic/students/{id} with Level 2 academic profile: identity, career/pensum, enrollment, inscriptions history, grades, current sections with schedule.

features.name: User Edit Professor S17 Fix
features.description: HLZ-20 (CRITICO): crash 500 cuando is_coordinator=true — StoreStaffProfileRequest usa exists:departments,id pero la tabla es coordinations. HLZ-21: fechas ISO 8601 en staff profile dejan input[type=date] vacíos. HLZ-04: PHPDoc ausente en StaffProfile.

features.name: User Seeder Sub-Record Fix
features.description: HLZ-22: UserSeeder no llama ensureSubRecord() — cada migrate:fresh --seed reproduce usuarios demo con rol pero sin sub-registro (Professor/Student/Guardian huérfanos).

features.name: User Edit Admin Fix
features.description: HLZ-14: DemographicProfileResource usa hasAnyRole(['Administrador','Coordinador']) en lugar de incluir 'Admin' — religion_id ausente del resource para admins, cada save de S04 nullifica religion_id silenciosamente.

features.name: User Edit Health Fix
features.description: HLZ-10/HLZ-15: S05 Salud — buildInitialFormData() lee h.blood_type?.name (objeto anidado ausente) en lugar de h.blood_type_id (ID plano presente). Dropdowns siempre vacíos en reload. Save destruye blood_type_id, disability_type_id, insurance_type_id existentes.

features.name: User Edit Student Sections Fix
features.description: HLZ-11 (S11 Familia), HLZ-12 (S12 Socioeconómico), HLZ-13 (S14 Vivienda): mismo patrón string/ID en tres secciones de estudiante. S11/S12 reload y save ambos rotos. S14 reload funciona pero save silenciosamente inefectivo.

features.name: User Edit S01 Identity Fix
features.description: HLZ-27/HLZ-28: S01 Identidad — 8 columnas de users (doc, fecha_nacimiento, género, nacionalidad, teléfonos, foto) no se exponen en UserEditResource ni se envían en el handler. Pérdida silenciosa de datos. Fix: catálogos dinámicos (documentTypes, genders, nationalities) + round-trip completo + AppDocInput refactor.
